extraction_notes.issue: Bid states '20-year limited warranty on TPO membrane' without specifying material-only vs labour-and-material vs NDL. Per skill taxonomy, recorded as 'unclear' pending owner clarification. Owner should request the manufacturer warranty exemplar referenced in attachments ('Sample Warranty Documentation').

Bid identifies '60 mil TPO' but does not name the manufacturer or system brand (e.g., Carlisle, GAF, Firestone, Johns Manville, Sika). Owner should request manufacturer identification before any award.
extraction_notes.evidence: KEY SPECIFICATIONS section and BID SUMMARY

extraction_notes.issue: No certified-installer status declared (no GAF Master Elite, Firestone Red Shield, Carlisle Authorized, Sika Sarnafil, etc.). A 20-yr manufacturer warranty typically requires certified installer designation. Owner should clarify.
extraction_notes.evidence: Absent from bid; not in ATTACHMENTS

extraction_notes.issue: Bid bond not listed in ATTACHMENTS section and no bonding capacity declared in body of bid. Defer to wave-2 mandatory-gates check; flag for owner if RFP requires bid bond.
Bid mentions 'Fall protection equipment provided' but does not confirm Working-at-Heights training under O.Reg 297/13. Owner should require WAH training records prior to award.
CGL limit of $5,000,000 declared but bid does not state whether owner (Tenebrus Capital) is named as additional insured. Verify on COI before award.
CGL limit declared but completed operations period not specified. Verify on COI.
Bid does not declare Skilled Trades Ontario C of Q roofer count on crew.

Bid contains 25 declared exclusions and 15 clarifications/assumptions, plus 11 'optional add-ons'. Many exclusions cover items typically expected in a roof replacement scope (cover board, tapered insulation for ponding, drain replacement, skylights, permits, after-hours work, hazardous materials, escalation). Net effect: base bid of $468K is not directly comparable to fully-compliant bids without monetizing the alternates and remaining open exclusions. Defer scope-divergence comparison to wave 2.
